name: shortcut-remote-adapter
description: Generated MCP-AQL adapter for Hanvon Ugee Shortcut Remote (USB 0x28bd:0x0202). JIT-discovered via observational HID capture.

read.name: list_devices
read.description: List currently connected Shortcut Remote devices.

read.name: get_device_info
read.description: Vendor/product info, manufacturer, serial, and inferred capabilities.

read.name: get_battery_status
read.description: Latest battery percent and charging state from the 0xf2 heartbeat report.

read.name: get_button_state
read.description: Most recent decoded button bitmap — which buttons are currently held.

read.name: wait_for_button_press
read.description: Block until the next button press, then return which bit transitioned and the raw report.

read.name: get_recent_events
read.description: Recent button/wheel events from the in-memory ring buffer.

since_ts.description: Unix ms; only events at or after this time.

read.name: is_device_open
read.description: Whether the adapter currently holds the vendor-page HID handle (true = keypad is LLM-only; false = XP-Pen daemon owns it).

read.name: get_hud_url
read.description: Return the URL of the live HUD (HTTP+WebSocket dashboard) bound to 127.0.0.1. Open it in a browser tab for a low-latency visual of every event.

read.name: get_current_layer
read.description: Return the adapter's current layer (1..4). Layer is the adapter's authoritative semantic state, advanced by K2, and broadcast on the WS as `layer_change` events.

read.name: get_wheel_value
read.description: Return the adapter's current wheel value (signed integer counter). Advances on CW ticks, retreats on CCW ticks. By default the adapter does not synthesize keystrokes for the wheel; if a binding has been set via set_wheel_binding, ticks also fire those keystrokes.

read.name: get_wheel_binding
read.description: Return the wheel's current keystroke binding (null = pure AI input, no synthesis). When set, CW/CCW ticks fire the bound keystroke in addition to broadcasting wheel_state.

update.name: set_current_layer
update.description: Set the adapter's current layer to a specific value (1..4). Triggers a `layer_change` broadcast just like a K2 press would.

layer.description: Layer to switch to (1-indexed; matches XP-Pen's I/II/III/IV labels).

source.description: Optional caller identifier surfaced in the broadcast event.

update.name: set_wheel_value
update.description: Set the adapter's wheel value to a specific number. Broadcasts a `wheel_state` event. Useful for clamping, jumping to a preset, or initializing the knob position from the LLM.

update.name: reset_wheel_value
update.description: Reset the wheel value to 0 and broadcast `wheel_state`. Equivalent to set_wheel_value with value=0.

update.name: post_annotation
update.description: Broadcast a free-form annotation payload as an `annotation` event for the HUD overlay. Used by MCP clients (LLMs) to display real-time semantic interpretation of wheel/K11 input. Recommended payload shape: { text: string, fields?: object, style?: 'info'|'warn'|'error' }. Pass payload=null to clear the overlay.

payload.description: Annotation payload (any JSON-serializable structure). Null/omitted = clear.

update.name: submit_voice_command
update.description: Submit a transcribed voice command. Adapter spawns `claude -p` with a smart system prompt; Claude calls back via this same MCP server to reconfigure (set_wheel_binding, etc.). Live progress broadcast as voice_command_received / annotation / wheel_binding_change events.

update.name: set_wheel_binding
update.description: Bind (or clear) the wheel to a keystroke. When set, CW ticks fire binding.cw, CCW ticks fire binding.ccw — both also continue to emit wheel_state events for AI observation. Pass binding=null to clear and return to pure AI mode. Mac key codes: see https://eastmanreference.com/complete-list-of-applescript-key-codes — common: 24=`=`, 27=`-`, 18-26=digits.

binding.description: Null to clear, or { cw?: { mac_code, modifiers?, label? }, ccw?: { mac_code, modifiers?, label? }, label?: string }. Modifiers are osascript names: 'command', 'option', 'control', 'shift'.

delete.name: release_device
delete.description: Release the vendor-page HID handle, returning the keypad to XP-Pen daemon control. Pending button-press waiters are aborted with timed_out=true. Any subsequent read op will lazy-reopen.
